goals: Verify the integration of server rendering and client rehydration for asynchronous components
Verify the rendering behavior of asynchronous components in browser and server environments, including loading states, error handling, and resolution caching
activities: Remove global.window to simulate a server environment
Create a server async context and a server app
Bootstrap the server app asynchronously
Render the server app to static markup and verify it matches the snapshot
Extract the client state from the server context and verify it matches the snapshot
Restore global.window to simulate a client environment
Create a client async context and a client app using the extracted client state
Bootstrap the client app asynchronously
Mount the client app and verify it matches the snapshot
Temporarily remove global.window, verify the client app's static markup matches the server HTML, and restore global.window
Wait for 100 milliseconds, update the mounted client app, and verify it matches the snapshot
Create an async component that throws an error on resolve and an app containing it
Bootstrap the app asynchronously, mount it, and wait briefly
Verify the mounted app's HTML contains the error message
Create an async component that increments a counter on resolve and an app containing it
Bootstrap the app asynchronously and mount it
Verify that the resolve counter equals 1
Mount the app a second time and verify that the resolve counter remains 1
Create an async component that resolves after a delay with a loading component and an app containing it
Bootstrap the app asynchronously and mount it
Verify the mounted app's HTML contains the loading text
Create an async component that rejects with an error for the server environment and an app containing it
Bootstrap the app asynchronously
Render the app to static markup and verify it contains the error message
